title: DNA Repair Mechanisms

title: Telomeres and Telomerase

title: Transcription: Initiation, Elongation, Termination

title: RNA Splicing and Alternative Splicing

title: The Genetic Code and Codon Usage

title: Ribosomes and the Mechanism of Translation
subject: Biology

title: Prokaryotic Gene Regulation: The lac Operon
subject: Biology
summary: The lac operon exemplifies negative and positive transcriptional control — repressed in the absence of lactose and fully activated only when lactose is present and glucose is absent.

title: Eukaryotic Transcriptional Regulation
subject: Biology

title: Epigenetic Regulation and Chromatin

title: PCR: Polymerase Chain Reaction

title: Lytic vs. Lysogenic Cycles in Bacteriophage

summary: Bacteriophages can follow a lytic cycle (immediate host destruction) or integrate as a prophage in the lysogenic cycle, remaining dormant until induced.

title: HIV and Retroviral Replication

title: Meiosis II: Separation of Sister Chromatids
subject: Biology

title: Nondisjunction and Aneuploidy

title: Meiosis Application: Gamete Diversity

title: Meiosis Application: Linkage Mapping

title: Meiosis Application: Human Pedigree Analysis
subject: Biology

title: Alleles, Genotype, and Phenotype
subject: Biology
summary: An allele is a variant form of a gene; genotype is the pair of alleles; phenotype is the observable trait.

title: Punnett Squares and Test Crosses
subject: Biology
summary: Punnett squares visually represent crosses and predict offspring ratios; test crosses reveal hidden recessive alleles.

title: Probability in Genetics
subject: Biology
summary: Probability rules quantify genetic predictions; multiplication rule applies to independent events; addition rule to mutually exclusive events.

title: Non-Mendelian Inheritance Patterns
subject: Biology
summary: Many traits don't follow simple Mendelian patterns; multiple alleles, gene interactions, and non-nuclear genes complicate inheritance.

title: Mendelian Genetics Application: Probability Problems
subject: Biology
summary: Multi-locus crosses require combining probabilities; predict offspring frequencies in complex genetic scenarios.

title: Mendelian Genetics Application: Corn and Fruit Flies
subject: Biology

title: Blood Type Genetics: Multiple Alleles

title: Sex-Linked Traits: X-Linked Patterns

title: Sex-Influenced and Sex-Limited Traits
subject: Biology

title: Non-Mendelian Application: Complex Pedigree Analysis
subject: Biology

subject: Biology
summary: Deletions remove genetic material; duplications add extra copies; both cause genetic imbalances that are usually harmful.

title: Inversions and Translocations
subject: Biology
summary: Inversions flip chromosome segments; translocations move segments between chromosomes; balanced rearrangements may have no phenotype.

title: Aneuploidy: Trisomy and Monosomy (Detailed)
subject: Biology

subject: Biology
summary: Karyotyping and molecular methods identify chromosomal abnormalities; prenatal diagnosis allows early detection and informed decision-making.

subject: Biology

subject: Biology

subject: Biology

subject: Biology

subject: Biology

subject: Biology
